reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.

description: A stationary fungus whose thick stalk and broad cap contain a mouthlike gill opening that produces an alarm shriek. Single rooted mushroom body with thick stalk and cap, no arms or legs. Smooth cap with sparse spots or folds, simple gill lines underneath. Large mushroom silhouette with stout stalk, broad cap, and an opened underside gill cavity.

visual_overrides.core_identity: A stationary fungus whose thick stalk and broad cap contain a mouthlike gill opening that produces an alarm shriek.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Large mushroom silhouette with stout stalk, broad cap, and an opened underside gill cavity.
visual_overrides.head_features: No animal head; the underside of the cap opens like a simple mouth or resonant gill chamber.
visual_overrides.body_shape: Single rooted mushroom body with thick stalk and cap, no arms or legs.
visual_overrides.surface: Smooth cap with sparse spots or folds, simple gill lines underneath.
visual_overrides.shape_lock: Draw one rooted mushroom only: one thick stalk anchored to the ground, one broad cap above it, and one large simple resonant gill opening on the underside of that cap. The opening may read mouthlike but has no teeth, lips, eyes, separate head, arms, legs, or tentacles.
visual_overrides.limb_structure: No limbs or tendrils. One rooted stalk supports one broad cap; the only active-looking structure is the single underside gill/resonant opening.
